eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 International Conference for Artificial Intelligence, Applications, Innovation and Ethics (AI2E)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Robotics and Control Systems; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence: Applications, Innovation and Ethics (AI²E-2027) provides an interdisciplinary forum for researchers, academics, industry professionals, policymakers, and practitioners to present and discuss recent advances in Artificial Intelligence. The conference covers emerging AI technologies, innovative AI-driven applications, and the ethical, social, and regulatory aspects of AI adoption. It promotes collaboration between academia, industry, and government to accelerate responsible AI research and real-world deployment in areas including education, healthcare, industry, digital economy, sustainable development, and other AI-enabled domains.
